title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 110
paragraphs: These coastal Greek cities, then, he passed, leaving them on his left. The Thracian tribes whose territory he marched through were the following: the Paeti, Cicones, Bistones, Sapaeans, Dersaeans, Edonians, and Satrae. Of these, those who lived along the coast accompanied him with their ships, while those of them who lived inland — the ones I have just listed — were compelled to accompany him on land, except the Satrae.
